% dcolumn's D columns with hyperref and amsmath: each cell's number as in
% the PDF, in a table float that a \ref leads to, with amsmath's thin
% space, and the separators of a column line up as in the PDF.
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{amsmath,dcolumn,booktabs,hyperref}
\begin{document}
See table~\ref{tab:numbers}.

\begin{table}[h]
\centering
\begin{tabular}{l D{.}{.}{2}}
    \toprule
    Label & \multicolumn{1}{c}{Value} \\
    \midrule
    Linked one & 1.25 \\
    Linked minus & -12.75 \\
    Linked integer & 3 \\
    Linked thin & 1\,234.5 \\
    Linked comma & 12,345 \\
    \bottomrule
\end{tabular}
\caption{Numbers}\label{tab:numbers}
\end{table}

Math after the table: $x = 1$.
\end{document}
